}}'''Architects''' are WIP Preeminent [[Mobs|Parasites]], that are spawned in [[Colony|Colonies]]. 

As of now, the Model is a placeholder/is unfinished, along with the sounds of an [[Overseer]].
==''Spawning''==
*Spawned by [[Colony|Colony Cores]].
*Spawned by [[Colony#Structures|Incomplete Parasitic Colony Structures]].
*Spawns in [[Colony|Colonies]], with a spawnweight of 20.

==''Behavior''==
Architects are Passive Utility Parasites, which construct [[Colony|Colonies]] by spawning [[Worker|Workers]].
*Architects use the same movement logic as the [[Overseer]], but lack their melee charge and ranged attacks.
**Architects do retain the [[Adaptation System|Adaptation]] values and Deterrent summons of [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure Parasites]], although this is likely placeholder.
*Architects passively drop [[Worker|Workers]].
*Architects can spawn [[Succor|Succors]].

===''Weaknesses''===
*Architects, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
